purpose: The Payment Gateway accepts card payments from merchants, routes them to acquiring banks, and publishes payment status events for other platform services.

components.name: Payments Edge Gateway
components.evidence: The Payments Edge Gateway is the single entrance for merchant traffic and passes validated requests to payments-core.

components.name: payments-core
components.evidence: payments-core holds the payment state machine and talks to the acquirer through the Acquirer connector.

components.name: Acquirer connector
components.evidence: The Acquirer connector is a thin adapter that maps our payment model to the message format of each acquirer, and it keeps no state of its own.

components.name: payment-events topic
components.evidence: the payment-events topic (Kafka) carries the status events.
